build.rationale: Modifies local filesystem by creating/updating site output files, but the effect is bounded to the site_dir and easily reversible by deletion.

gh-deploy.rationale: Publishes documentation to a public remote service (GitHub Pages) and commits/pushes to a remote branch, modifying shared production state.

new.rationale: Creates new local project files and directories in a specified location, but the effect is bounded and reversible.

serve.rationale: Starts a local development server with optional rebuilds on file changes; modifies local filesystem temporarily during development and is fully reversible.
